1.t: O thou wrapped up (in the mantle)!

3.t: And thy Lord do thou magnify!

4.t: And thy garments keep free from stain!

6.t: Nor expect, in giving, any increase (for thyself)!

7.t: But, for thy Lord's (Cause), be patient and constant!

8.t: Finally, when the Trumpet is sounded,

9.t: That will be- that Day - a Day of Distress,-

10.t: Far from easy for those without Faith.

11.t: Leave Me alone, (to deal) with the (creature) whom I created (bare and) alone!-

12.t: To whom I granted resources in abundance,

13.t: And sons to be by his side!-

14.t: To whom I made (life) smooth and comfortable!

15.t: Yet is he greedy-that I should add (yet more);-

16.t: By no means! For to Our Signs he has been refractory!

17.t: Soon will I visit him with a mount of calamities!

18.t: For he thought and he plotted;-

19.t: And woe to him! How he plotted!-

20.t: Yea, Woe to him; How he plotted!-

22.t: Then he frowned and he scowled;

23.t: Then he turned back and was haughty;

24.t: Then said he: "This is nothing but magic, derived from of old;

25.t: "This is nothing but the word of a mortal!"

26.t: Soon will I cast him into Hell-Fire!

27.t: And what will explain to thee what Hell-Fire is?

28.t: Naught doth it permit to endure, and naught doth it leave alone!-

29.t: Darkening and changing the colour of man!

31.t: And We have set none but angels as Guardians of the Fire; and We have fixed their number only as a trial for Unbelievers,- in order that the People of the Book may arrive at certainty, and the Believers may increase in Faith,- and that no doubts may be left for the People of the Book and the Believers, and that those in whose hearts is a disease and the Unbelievers may say, "What symbol doth Allah intend by this?" Thus doth Allah leave to stray whom He pleaseth, and guide whom He pleaseth: and none can know the forces of thy Lord, except He and this is no other than a warning to mankind.

33.t: And by the Night as it retreateth,

34.t: And by the Dawn as it shineth forth,-

35.t: This is but one of the mighty (portents),

37.t: To any of you that chooses to press forward, or to follow behind;-

38.t: Every soul will be (held) in pledge for its deeds.

39.t: Except the Companions of the Right Hand.

40.t: (They will be) in Gardens (of Delight): they will question each other,

43.t: They will say: "We were not of those who prayed;

44.t: "Nor were we of those who fed the indigent;

45.t: "But we used to talk vanities with vain talkers;

46.t: "And we used to deny the Day of Judgment,

47.t: "Until there came to us (the Hour) that is certain."

48.t: Then will no intercession of (any) intercessors profit them.

49.t: Then what is the matter with them that they turn away from admonition?-

50.t: As if they were affrighted asses,

52.t: Forsooth, each one of them wants to be given scrolls (of revelation) spread out!

53.t: By no means! But they fear not the Hereafter,

54.t: Nay, this surely is an admonition:

55.t: Let any who will, keep it in remembrance!

56.t: But none will keep it in remembrance except as Allah wills: He is the Lord of Righteousness, and the Lord of Forgiveness.
